description: Fresh EN municipal records-management admission domain.

units.title: Contract retention
units.text: Executed contracts are retained for seven years after the contract is closed, unless a legal hold requires a longer period.

units.title: Legal hold
units.text: When a legal hold is issued, scheduled destruction is suspended for every record within the hold scope until the hold is formally released.

units.title: Request intake
units.text: The public records coordinator logs each incoming request, records the received date, and assigns the request to the department that holds the responsive records.

units.title: Redaction before release
units.text: Before public release, staff redact information covered by a statutory exemption. The unredacted master remains restricted and is not substituted with the public copy.

units.title: Release formats
units.text: Training examples show releases in PDF and CSV depending on the records involved. The policy does not require one universal file format for every request.

units.title: Request fees
units.text: Any applicable fee follows the currently published fee schedule. This procedure does not state a fixed dollar amount that applies to every records request.

questions.query: How long are executed contracts retained after they close?
